name: Why is professional installation important for shower enclosures, especially for frameless designs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional installation by an experienced team like AKN Design Group is crucial for shower enclosures, particularly for frameless glass designs. These installations require precise measurements, expert handling of heavy glass panels, and specialized knowledge to ensure structural integrity, proper sealing, and safe operation. Improper installation can lead to leaks, instability, or even glass breakage. Our two decades of experience and commitment to craftsmanship ensure that every enclosure is installed to the highest standards, preventing future issues and guaranteeing the long-term beauty and functionality of your spa-inspired bathroom. It's a critical component of enhancing functionality and value.
